title: Blue Lives Matter? Or, Police Reform — Chicago style
text: Copyright 2015 by Eric J. Garcia, reprinted with permission. Today’s Tribune report on Rahm Emanuel’s new choice for police superintendent, Eddie Johnson, is a good example of deadline reporting. By “good example,” I mean that it mostly channels the official sources, and so gets the story wrong. It stays within the frame delivered to us by the Mayor’s people: What is most important is pleasing the cops, whose morale has suffered from community outrage, and pleasing the black and Latino aldermen.
